raw_segments.text: When her dear Papa, Captain Crew, brought her from India and gave her into my care,
the speech proceeded. He said to me, in a jesting way,
I am afraid she will be very rich, Miss Minchin. My reply was,
Her education at my seminary, Captain Crew, shall be such as will adorn the largest fortune.
Sarah has become my most accomplished pupil. Her French and her dancing are a credit to
the seminary, her manners which have caused you to call her Princess Sarah perfect.
Her Aimee ability she exhibits by giving you this afternoon's party.
I hope you appreciate her generosity. I wish you to express your
appreciation of it by saying aloud altogether. Thank you, Sarah.
